Data from methods/code-analysis/datasets.py DATASETS. Formula placeholders: {r}, {MAXR}, {rng:Sheet.col_id}, {col:col_id}, {cell:col_id}, {L:token}, {p:param}, {row}, {x:phase_in_scope}; text placeholders {engagement.client}, {target.platform}, {unit.noun} ... from the merged run configuration. deliverables.de.json has the same structure (same column ids/fields; only wording and sheet names are translated). readme.glossary_text: {unit.noun} = deployable module of the shop code. {target.api_name} = standard API of the target platform, base of the target storefront. {target.content_model_name} = configurable page building block. Service override = a standard component replaced by an own implementation. Shadowing = an own class with the same name and namespace overlays the standard class (high upgrade risk). Data script = import, migration or master-data script. Workflow = configured process (e.g. order processing). Clean core = {unit.noun} without patches of standard behaviour. Cleaned LOC = maintained code lines of loaded {unit.noun_plural} without tests, generated code, template copies, configuration and data scripts. Customer-facing = {unit.noun_plural} of the categories frontend and API. Key statement = one sentence on what the result means for {engagement.client}. Rank = order of a migration task within its impact class. Sources (client list) = abbreviations of the documents a requirement rests on (resolved on the sheet Source_abbreviations).
